description: Token balances for wallet X on chain Y — every ERC-20/native token held by an address, with USD quotes. Works across 100+ chains via Covalent/GoldRush. Example: covalent_token_balances({ address: "0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045", chain: "eth-mainnet", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Covalent / GoldRush API key (free tier at goldrush.dev)

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), ENS name, or other supported domain

chain.description: Chain name (Covalent format), e.g. "eth-mainnet", "matic-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "bsc-mainnet", "arbitrum-mainnet". A numeric chain id also works. Default "eth-mainnet".

name: covalent_token_balances
title: Covalent Token Balances
